claim: The official benchmark count is 2,302 semantic questions and 4,604 ES/EN records.
The pilot is planned for 15 September 2026.
Reconstruction produced 1,840 training semantic questions, 230 development questions, and 232 test questions.
Validation identifies zero orphaned pairs and zero divided groups.
BM25 achieves recall@10 of 0.69 and MRR of 0.52.
The hybrid system achieves recall@10 of 0.80 and MRR of 0.63.
Hybrid retrieval improves semantic, multi-hop, and temporal questions in particular.
BM25 remains competitive for exact identifiers and low-ambiguity strings.
The main configuration uses 256-token chunks.
Finding 1 indicates that hybrid retrieval improves semantic retrieval.
evidence: The conclusion is supported by metrics and example review.
